   → [Search PA Census Index](https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/3570?name=Patrick_Flynn&residence=1870_Schuylkill%2C+Pennsylvania%2C+United+States)

6. **National Library of Ireland (registers.nli.ie)** – Free access to Catholic parish registers on microfilm.
7. **PRONI (Public Record Office of Northern Ireland)** – If the family may be from Ulster counties.

Since civil birth registration in Ireland only began in **1864**, a birth around 1845 would typically appear only in **Catholic or Church of Ireland baptismal registers**. IrishGenealogy.ie and the NLI registers are the best free starting points.
